Leaf line

## Effortless Space Connectivity, Redefined

**We offer seamless access to satellites via a global network of interconnected ground stations.**

LEAF LINE is LEAF SPACE’s Ground Segment as a Service solution, leveraging a fully owned and operated global network of ground stations available through all-inclusive per-minute pricing. This service enables satellite operators to efficiently perform mission-critical data communication with their space assets.

LEAF LINE supports Command & Control (TT&C) operations by receiving telemetry data and transmitting commands to satellites, while also managing mission-critical communication by handling the reception and transmission of payload data.

The Leaf Line network serves satellite operators around the world, with over 50% of operations supporting missions from the United States.

About us

## we connect the world

Leaf Space connects the world’s space assets, enabling organizations to access in-orbit data faster, more easily, and with greater reliability. With a global network of owned and operated ground stations, we provide comprehensive coverage, ensuring you’re supported regardless of your mission profile.

Our smart & autonomous scheduling, unified platform, transparent pricing, and dedicated support make Leaf Space the top choice for both new satellite operators and large constellations

- We offer global coverage that enables you to scale your operations while optimizing cost efficiency.
- Our Software Defined Radio (SDR) suite supports the most advanced waveforms and communication protocols from various satellite radios, ensuring the broadest RF communication compatibility in the market.
- We provide a scalable and transparent cost model that simplifies understanding your expenses as your mission grows. Plus, there's no minimum usage commitment.

Faqs

## questions we hear the most

Explore our most frequently asked questions. We’ve collected the topics that matter most to you, providing clear, straightforward answers to help you understand our services better.

Read all FAQ

What is the latency that can be achieved by your network?

That will depend on many factors such as mission profile and geometry.

As of Q4 2025, for an SSO mission at 55 km altitude, the average gap between two consecutive contacts is around 15 minutes.

For mid-inclination missions, that average is closer to 13 minutes.

Our network is constantly expanding and all these value are bound to evolve and improve in time.

What protocol/communication Scheme do you support?

We have already integrated the protocols and the radios from of the main manufacturers of the new space industry to provide the widest compatibility in the market. Standard solutions like CCSDS, DVB-S2 are, of course, supported. If needed, we have the capability to ensure compatibility with new protocol and radios within our own SDR (Software Defined Radio) suite.

Is there a priority scheme for different customers?

Yes, in a few specific cases where it aligns with the appropriate concept of operations.

What kind of support does Leaf Space provide during nominal operations?

Leaf Space guarantee 12h of continuous support every day of the year, from 6:00 UTC until 18:00 UTC (or from 7:00 UTC until 19:00 UTC according to the different periods of the solar year). Our high level of automation in network operations has enabled us to streamline support to 12 hours, ensuring efficiency without compromising on service quality.
